DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_FlowerPrince:
Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil.
What it protects, and for what purpose, <characterName id=|FlowerPrince|/> does not care.
After all, the World Tree knows everything.
Only the mist it wields can reveal the truth.

Condenses its mist into <itemName id=|Corrosive_Solvent| style=|Status_Keyword|/> when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_ThunderDragonMan:
It sends electricity into its foes' wounds, roasting them from the inside out. 
Fights between <characterName id=|ThunderDragonMan|/> end in the blink of an eye.

Bottles its abundant electricity into <itemName id=|Bio_Battery| style=|Status_Keyword|/> for its tamer while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_MonochromeQueen:
Joy and misery come in equal measure for <characterName id=|MonochromeQueen|/>. 
Those who choose to take care of one must be prepared for what that entails.

Bottles its misery into <itemName id=|Bio_Coolant| style=|Status_Keyword|/>, saving only its joy for its tamer while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_FlowerPrince:
When activated, 
the player's attacks inflict <uiCommon id=|ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Poison| style=|Effect_Poison|/> <Status_Up>{ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}</>.

While in party, 
grants the player and party Pals immunity to <uiCommon id=|ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Poison| style=|Effect_Poison|/>, and <Status_Keyword>nullifies the effects of toxic gas</> in the World Tree area. 
(Does not stack)

Condenses its mist into <itemName id=|Corrosive_Solvent| style=|Status_Keyword|/> when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_ThunderDragonMan:
While in party, 
hitting an enemy with a bullet increases the Attack and Defense of the Pal fighting alongside you by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> for 5 seconds.
This effect stacks up to 30 times. (Does not stack.)

Bottles its abundant electricity into <itemName id=|Bio_Battery| style=|Status_Keyword|/> for its tamer while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_MonochromeQueen:
While in party, 
increases the player's Attack by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> if all Pals in party are different species. 
(Does not stack)

Bottles its misery into <itemName id=|Bio_Coolant| style=|Status_Keyword|/>, saving only its joy for its tamer while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
